parameters.content:
## Google Flights Fare & Itinerary Filter Scraper

**Actor:** [Google Flights Fare & Itinerary Filter Scraper](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/google-flights-fare-and-itinerary-filter-scraper)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/google-flights-fare-and-itinerary-filter-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `originAirport` (string)
- `destinationAirport` (string)
- `outboundDate` (string)
- `returnDate` (string)
- `adults` (integer)
- `children` (integer)
- `infants` (integer)
- `infantsInSeat` (integer)
- `cabinClass` (string)
- `currency` (string)
- `language` (string)

### Output fields
- `price` (Price)
- `currency` (Currency)
- `airline` (Airline)
- `departureAirport` (Departure Airport)
- `departureTime` (Departure Time)
- `arrivalAirport` (Arrival Airport)
- `arrivalTime` (Arrival Time)
- `durationMinutes` (Duration Minutes)
- `stops` (Stops)
- `emissionsGrams` (Emissions Grams)
- `bookingUrl` (Booking Url)

description: Google Flights fare scraper: runs the Google Flights Fare & Itinerary Filter Scraper Apify Actor, returns price, airline, departureAirport, departureTime, arrivalAirport and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
